propositions: The project.portability criterion's Platform and venue matrix cell treats CI as a single undifferentiated option, leaving both non-GitHub-Actions CI providers and projects with no CI provider as unnameable alternate shapes.

Capabilities with GitHub-Actions-only triggers and no operation-linked or in-process fallback silently break adopters on other CI systems or with no CI, because the criterion cannot detect this hard dependency.

The criterion detection text, matrix cell wording, and doc mirrors must be extended to name both CI-provider diversity and no-CI-provider scenarios as supported platforms, with a rule that sole-trigger CI dependencies require fallbacks.
String pinning and live A/B testing verify that the rule ships and fires correctly: a scratch GitHub-Actions-only compaction plan draws a project.portability finding post-change but not pre-change.
